purpose: A thin rule that divides content horizontally or vertically, solid or dashed, with an optional label such as OR at its start, centre or end. Use it sparingly; whitespace is usually enough.

notFor.case: Grouping content inside a surface with an edge.
Space between blocks that needs no visible line.

Default.visual: Line Border/default (default), Border/subtle (subtle) or Border/strong (strong); label Content/secondary.

a11y.role: none when decorative (the default); separator with aria-orientation when it conveys structure

openQuestions: When the separator is not decorative and has a label, does the label name it (aria-label)? The contract does not say.
